dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Excuse me! Could you help me? I am looking for the central post office. I think it is near here, but I cannot find it.

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: Yes, of course! You are on the right street. Walk straight on along this road for about three minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Three minutes straight on. OK. And then?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: At the end of this road, you will reach a big crossroads. Turn left at the crossroads.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Turn left at the crossroads. Got it. And then what do I look for?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: After you turn left, you will see a tall red-brick building on your right. That is the city library. Walk past the library and continue along the road.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Past the red-brick library on the right. And then the post office?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: Almost! Keep going until you reach a small park. The post office is directly opposite the park — you can see it from the park entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Opposite the park — that is easy to remember! Is there a bus stop near the post office?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a bus stop right in front of the post office, next to the park gates. Buses number 4 and 7 stop there.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Perfect! And how long does it take on foot from here?

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: About ten to twelve minutes. It is not far at all. And if you get confused, the library is your landmark — you can see it from most of the road.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: That is very helpful. Thank you so much — you explained it really clearly!

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.text: You are welcome! Good luck — and enjoy exploring Uralsk!

task1Items.question: Zara is looking for the city library.
Marat tells Zara to turn left at the crossroads.
The city library is on the left side of the road after the crossroads.
The post office is directly opposite a small park.
Bus numbers 4 and 7 stop in front of the post office.
The post office is about twenty minutes away on foot.

Said to walk straight and then turn left at the crossroads.
Described the tall red-brick library as a landmark on the right.
Asked about the bus stop near the post office.
